Note : The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster
questions.solution_en:
Options:

1) RST

Letters are in sequential alphabetical order: R→S→T.

2) BCD

Letters are in sequential alphabetical order: B→C→D.

3) ONM

Letters are in reverse alphabetical order: O→N→M

4) JKL

Letters are in sequential alphabetical order: J→K→L.

Odd one out:

· ONM is the only cluster with letters in reverse alphabetical order.

· All other clusters (BCD, RST, JKL) have letters in sequential alphabetical order.

· Option (c) is the correct answer.
